nodes.label: Atomic Function Layer
nodes.description: Abstraction layer between VoiceNlpAdapter and RobotModbusService. Categories: E (emergency), J (joint), V (virtual axis), C (cartesian), D (delay), SP (speed/step), IO, Q (query). Maps natural language intents to MODBUS Func calls with wake word 'xiaozheng' isolation.

nodes.label: Wake Word Isolation
nodes.description: System requires wake word 'xiaozheng' before processing voice commands. Prevents accidental robot activation from ambient speech. One of seven core design principles of the atomic function layer.

nodes.label: Risk Grading
nodes.description: Atomic functions classified by risk level determining confirmation requirements. High-risk operations require explicit user confirmation; low-risk operations may auto-execute.
